  1. Contact

Contact us

Four addresses rather than one, so your message reaches whoever can actually deal with it.

  • Buying a car

    Questions about a specific vehicle go to the dealership directly, using the enquiry button on the listing. They have the car and the paperwork. For anything about the platform itself, write to us.

    hello@rynet.co.za

  • Listing your dealership

    If you run a registered dealership and want your stock on Rynet, this is the address. Tell us your trading name, your CIPC registration number and roughly how many units you carry.

    dealers@rynet.co.za

  • Reporting a listing or a dealership

    If a listing is wrong, or a dealership did not turn out to be what the listing suggested, tell us. This is the main way we find out, and it is how a dealership ends up suspended.

    report@rynet.co.za

  • Privacy and your information

    Access, correction and deletion requests under POPIA, and anything else about how we handle personal information.

    privacy@rynet.co.za
Pretoria, Gauteng, South Africa

If something on the site is difficult to use, there is a separate address on the accessibility page.
